name: apps

# The cheap half. An app cannot move money, skip an audit record or weaken an
# invariant — the runtime and the database decide those, and the framework workflow
# proves it. So app CI only asks: did it stay inside the boundary, does it typecheck,
# does it build? Anything heavier would be theatre, and slow app work down for nothing.
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "apps/console/**"
      - ".github/workflows/apps.yml"

jobs:
  apps:
    name: boundary, typecheck, build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      # Fails if an app imports the kernel, the data layer, a capability handler,
      # `pg`, or calls `fetch` directly.
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run build:console
